desc: write netplan YAML configuration snippets to file
u: netplan-set - write netplan YAML configuration snippets to file

netplan set [key=value] writes a given key/value pair or YAML subtree into a YAML file in /etc/netplan/ and validates its format.

You can specify a single value as: "[network.]ethernets.eth0.addresses=[1.2.3.4/24, 5.6.7.8/24]" or a full subtree as: "[network.]ethernets.eth0={dhcp4: true, dhcp6: true}".

For details of the configuration file format, see netplan(5).

<dl><dt data-o="">-h, --help</dt><dd>Print basic help.</dd><dt data-o="">--debug</dt><dd>Print debugging output during the process.</dd><dt data-o="">--root-dir</dt><dd>Write YAML files into this root instead of /</dd><dt data-o="">--origin-hint</dt><dd>Specify a name for the config file, e.g.: 70-netplan-set => /etc/netplan/70-netplan-set.yaml</dd></dl>
